messages:
jamal: Quick heads-up — running the AWQ-int8 candidate vs fp8 baseline on the JSON-struct suite and seeing a small hallucination spike.
jamal: Baseline halluc rate ~0.9% -> candidate ~4.5% (5/200 prompts). Happening on aws-g5dn pool, serving profile 'prod-shared-2'. Link to logs: https://internal.redwood/ci/artifacts/2265432 :eyes:
maria: Can you paste the exact commit + quant cfg used? also seed?
jamal: commit: a1b2c3d4, quant profile: awq-aggressive-v3, seed=42, batch_size=1 in eval, but serving test used shared pool with max_batch=8.
sophia: eval-bot summary attached:
```
artifact: s3://redwood-evals/2265432/summary.json
metrics:
  hallucination_rate:
    baseline_fp8: 0.009
    awq_candidate: 0.045
  avg_response_len: 24.3 vs 24.1
  formatted_json_errors: 0.6% -> 2.1%
```
(small sample, full CSV in artifact)
ryan: interesting — candidate only shows this on structured JSON task? any diffs in tokenizer or prompt preprocessing?
jamal: tokenizer same. prompt trimming identical. suspect boundary tokens / KV cache eviction due to mixed batch pattern on shared pool.
ben: Could be shared-pool packing + AWQ rounding at attention boundaries. Repro with forced single-threaded serving (no splitpack) to see if it's batching artifact.
carla: Proposed triage plan:
- reproduce locally with same commit & awq-aggressive-v3, run 1000-sample canary with batch=1 and batch=8
- run GPTQ-int8 candidate (we already have) to compare — previous run showed no spike
- run a KV-eviction stress test with prefix-preserve toggled
- if repro, bisect awq quant table (scale/clamp) and try awq-aggressive-v2

carla: I'll kick off the canary, assigning to jamal to run the batch=1/8 runs.
jamal: started canary job: `./scripts/run_eval --artifact s3://redwood-evals/2265432 --commit a1b2c3d4 --batch 1` -> job id 2265432-01
eval-bot: Canary job queued: 2265432-01. Will post results to the thread when complete.
maria: thanks — if we can rule out quantization algorithm (AWQ) vs serving infra, we can decide revert vs config tweak. If it's infra, rollback not necessary.
ryan: quick check — were CPU kernels different on g5dn vs our dedicated g5-like nodes? small FP->INT paths sometimes fallback to simd x86 paths.
jamal: checked kernel table: both using avx2 kernels, same lib build. only diff is shared-pool allocator + splitpack true on prod-shared-2.
ben: also add run with AWQ but forced deterministic rounding (if available) to see noise vs systematic shift.
carla: ok will add deterministic run to the plan. tagging this as P1 for the bakeoff triage. :thinking_face:
(silence for a bit)
eval-bot: Canary job complete: 2265432-01
eval-bot: results:
```
batch=1 -> halluc_rate=0.011 (close to baseline)
batch=8 -> halluc_rate=0.043 (matches earlier spike)
```
jamal: that's pretty conclusive — batch packing is amplifying the AWQ error mode.
maria: great triage. next steps:
- short-term: pin serving profile for this model to max_batch=1 for rollout (ops)
- medium: add guard in Optimize that warns for AWQ profiles when shared-pool + splitpack enabled
- long-term: work with quant team to adjust scale-clamp for batch-aware behavior
ben: I'll open a tickets:
  - infra: enforce per-model max_batch override (ops)
  - quant: run batch-aware quant sweep (research)

carla: will do canary rollout with max_batch=1 and monitor eval metrics + 1% traffic start.
jamal: thanks everyone. filing postmortem notes in doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/quant/bakeoffs/2265432
maria: :thumbsup:
